text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: Synthetic check 'canary-eu-frontend-1' fired (5 failures in 2m). Trigger=502_rate>10%. Probe: GET https://canary-eu.redwood-inference/internal/canary -> 502. Page routed to rotation #eng-oncall. Link: https://pagerduty.example/INC12345

pagerduty: PagerDuty note: Alert INC12345 created and notified on-call. Priority: P1. Escalation policy: eng-oncall -> eng-sre.

alex: Acked. I'm the current on-call. Jumping in. Any idea if this is a probe-only issue or production traffic?

jen: I'm seeing a small uptick in 502s from EU edge -> backend inference pool for models with large kv cache sizes. Grafana: eu-edge->inference 502 rate +12% over baseline. No customer pages yet.

samir: pulling logs for canary run now. quick curl from my laptop: `curl -si https://canary-eu.redwood-inference/internal/canary` returns `HTTP/1.1 502
Content-Type: application/json

{"error":"inference_service_error","msg":"kvcache-mismatch"}`

lydia: @alex fyi we rolled a minor kernel/quantization config to eu-dedicated last night. Rollout was canaryed to 10% — could be related. I'm checking rollout history.

ops-bot: Runbook: "Canary / Synthetic check failures" -> https://playbooks.redwood/runbooks/canary-failures. Suggested first steps: 1) confirm prod impact 2) disable synthetic if noisy 3) fallback routing.

alex: Confirming prod impact: sampling live traffic via trace id shows ~0.4% of customer requests from EU got 502 in last 5m, mostly for long-context models (seq_len>2048). Risk: customer-visible but small. I'll escalate if >1%.

jen: Quick mitigation suggestion: disable canary probe temporarily to stop noisy paging while we triage, and put rule to route new requests to eu-standby region for affected model variant. Can we flip route at infra layer?

samir: I can flip routing for the affected model group to eu-standby (same hw class). Command I use: `redwood infra route set --model-group long-context --from-region eu-west-1 --to-region eu-west-2 --dry-run` then without `--dry-run`. Will wait for ack.

alex: Do it. First disable the probe to silence pages: `curl -X POST https://control-plane.redwood/api/v1/canaries/canary-eu-frontend-1/disable -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"` (ops has token). @lydia please confirm you won't roll anything else while we debug.

lydia: pausing rollouts for eu for the next 2 hours. I'm checking the quantization kernel changes for anything touching kv cache handling.

samir: routing change applied (at 1813456902). Verified traffic split changed to standby. Logs show reduced requests to primary pool.

jen: Probe disabled (at 1813456930). Pager silenced but keeping thread open.

alex: Monitoring: 502s down to baseline (~1-2% ephemeral). Customer impact appears mitigated for now. Creating INC12345 ticket and linking to postmortem.

incident-bot: Incident INC12345 created: https://incidents.redwood/INC12345. Severity: P2 (customer impact limited after mitigation). Assigned: alex, samir, lydia.

samir: Next steps: collect core dumps from affected inference hosts, run regression tests against quantization kernel, and prepare rollback of last kernel patch if repro.

jen: I'll notify CS for potential customer outreach if patterns persist. For now, marking as handled but leaving monitoring in place for 30m. :thumbsup:

alex: Thanks all. I'll hand off to samir for deep triage. If anything spikes, re-page the rotation.

samir: taking post-triage ownership. Will update here with timeline and RCA plan.

ops-bot: Automation note: Canary check re-enable scheduled for 1813458800 (30m) unless manually re-enabled earlier.

alex: closing on-call handoff — handing to samir.

samir: last note: preserved raw logs and probes in /var/log/canary/INC12345/ for 7d.

jen: 👍
